exam_scheme.note: The Jawaharlal Nehru University Entrance Examination (JNUEE) was historically the dedicated university-wide entrance test administered by the National Testing Agency (NTA) for Jawaharlal Nehru University (JNU), New Delhi. In conformity with University Grants Commission directives, JNU now conducts admissions to its undergraduate programmes (B.A. Hons. in Foreign Languages, B.Sc.-M.Sc. Integrated programmes) via CUET-UG, its postgraduate master's programmes (M.A., M.Sc., MCA, MPH) via CUET-PG administered by NTA, and Ph.D. programmes via the NTA Ph.D. Entrance Examination / NET-JRF. For CUET-PG admissions, candidates appear in the respective domain-specific test code comprising 75 multiple-choice questions (300 marks) in Computer Based Test (CBT) mode of 105 minutes duration with a marking scheme of +4 for correct and -1 for incorrect responses. JNU uniquely applies a Deprivation Points policy (up to 12 additional points added to the composite score for candidates from backward districts, female candidates, and transgender applicants) to determine the final selection list.
